name: PayCheckpoint Local Conversation Sequence Regression Set v1
purpose: Deterministic regression checks for ordered message-pattern rules in a Bangladesh MFS consumer-support context.
limitations: All conversations are fictional and developer-authored.
This is not a representative sample of real scam conversations or benign conversations.
Expected pattern labels were authored by the project team and have not been independently adjudicated.
Passing these cases does not establish precision, recall, fraud-detection accuracy, or safety in production.
